description: PERCENTILE_CONT / PERCENTILE_DISC via WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY <expr>): the function argument is the fraction p and the ORDER BY expression supplies the data. Previously the WITHIN GROUP clause was a parse error and the accumulator hardcoded p = 0.5 over the constant function argument. PERCENTILE_CONT interpolates - p=0.9 over [10,20,30,40,100] lands at index 3.6, so 40*0.4 + 100*0.6 = 76 - while PERCENTILE_DISC returns a value actually present in the set, and both compute per group. Converted 1:1 from functions/PercentileTest (now retired); its @BeforeEach fixture is inlined per test.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE p (grp INTEGER, x DOUBLE)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x) AS r FROM p WHERE grp = 1
CREATE TABLE p (grp INTEGER, x DOUBLE)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x) AS r FROM p WHERE grp = 1
CREATE TABLE p (grp INTEGER, x DOUBLE)
SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x) AS r FROM p WHERE grp = 1
SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x) AS r FROM p WHERE grp = 1
CREATE TABLE p (grp INTEGER, x DOUBLE)
SELECT grp, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x) AS r FROM p GROUP BY grp ORDER BY grp
